setup.description: Install Java (21 by default) through setup-java, verify Android command-line tools, install selected SDK packages, and publish their environment.

version.description: Pinned Google command-line tools archive build ID; nondefault builds require archiveUrl and archiveSha256. Default: "15859902".

javaVersion.description: Java release or supported selector forwarded to the typed setup-java dependency; defaults to Java 21. Default: "21".

sdkRoot.description: Absolute SDK root; defaults to a per-user directory keyed by the command-line tools build.

packages.description: Comma-separated native Android SDK package IDs, such as platform-tools,platforms;android-36,build-tools;36.0.0. Blank installs no packages through this field. Default: "platform-tools".

apiLevels.description: Comma-separated API levels or preview names; installs platforms;android-VALUE for each entry.

buildToolsVersions.description: Comma-separated Android build-tools revisions to install and add to PATH.

ndkVersions.description: Comma-separated side-by-side NDK revisions to install; ANDROID_NDK_HOME selects the first.

cmakeVersions.description: Comma-separated SDK CMake revisions to install and add to PATH.

systemImages.description: Comma-separated complete system-image package IDs; no emulator or virtual device is started.

packageFile.description: Existing file of newline-separated SDK package IDs, passed to sdkmanager.

channel.description: Highest SDK repository channel to include: 0 stable, 1 beta, 2 dev, or 3 canary. Default: 0.

acceptLicenses.description: Accept SDK licenses noninteractively. False uses existing licenses and closed stdin; missing licenses fail installation. Default: true.

proxyType.description: SDK proxy protocol: http or socks; requires proxyHost and proxyPort.

proxyHost.description: SDK repository proxy hostname or IP address.

proxyPort.description: SDK proxy port from 1 to 65535 when a proxy is enabled.

sdkManagerArgs.description: Additional literal sdkmanager option/value tokens as comma-separated text; cannot change the managed operation or SDK root.

archiveUrl.description: Optional HTTPS command-line tools ZIP URL for mirrors or alternate builds; requires archiveSha256.

archiveSha256.description: Lowercase SHA-256 of the alternate ZIP. Default Google downloads use pinned platform checksums.
